name: PubMed abstracts on arginine, published before 1990 — the 3,642 records of the July 2026 blind collection
source: PubMed E-utilities (https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/), efetch rettype=abstract, text taken in full by itertext()
selection: blind collection for an unrelated experiment (a dormant-link test): PubMed search on arginine and its physiological effects (growth hormone, hormonal secretion, metabolism, insulin), strict date bound before 1990-01-01 re-checked record by record (2 excluded for an ambiguous year), and every record mentioning somatomedin or IGF in title or abstract set aside (51 PMIDs, listed below). What remains is 3,642 records: title, year, abstract when PubMed has one.
note: Read on 2026-08-08 as the first real corpus of the observation campaign (Korela For Science, document 04): a fifth of the records have only a title; titles of the 1960s are in full capitals; OCR noise reaches technical terms ('penicilhn'). The abstracts are PubMed's; they are not redistributed here, the PMID list is.
how_to_reproduce: For each PMID: GET https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi?db=pubmed&id=<PMID>&rettype=abstract&retmode=xml . PubMed may have corrected a record since 2026-07-29; a re-download is a new snapshot, to be dated. The probe probes/2026-08/line-064-arginine-titles.py expects one record per '## n. PMID x · year' heading with the title in bold on the next line.
